IB 2027 · HL

Unit 5: Scalable Data Systems

Themes A3.3-A3.4 | 3 Weeks

Unit overview

How do we handle Data at Global Scale?

This unit covers 4 IB Computer Science sub-topics: A3.3.4, A3.4.1, A3.4.2, and A3.4.3.

The focus areas are SQL Aggregate functions, Alternative databases, Data warehouses, and OLAP & Data Mining.

Coverage

  • A3.3.4 SQL Aggregate functions
  • A3.4.1 Alternative databases
  • A3.4.2 Data warehouses
  • A3.4.3 OLAP & Data Mining

Objectives and outcomes

Code What You Will Learn What You Should Be Able To Do
A3.3.4 SQL Aggregate functions Construct calculations using SQL's aggregate functions.
A3.4.1 Alternative databases Outline different types of databases (NoSQL, etc.).
A3.4.2 Data warehouses Explain primary objectives of data warehouses.
A3.4.3 OLAP & Data Mining Explain role of OLAP and data mining for business intelligence.
